function.parameter:
Create a complete, highly polished, interactive "God Game Civilization Simulator" web application in Spanish, designed for a University Data Structures project (Entrega Parcial 1 & Proyección Final).
Key Features Required: 1. Interactive Map Grid (50x50 cells rendered smoothly on an HTML5 Canvas): - Procedural terrain generation using a deterministic Seed input (biomes: Océano, Llanura, Bosque, Montaña, Desierto). - 4 initial civilizations (Imperio Aethel, República Boreal, Dinastía Solaris, Confederación Valka) with distinct territory colors, capitals, villages, and cities. - Hover/Click on any cell to inspect its complete attributes in a side panel: Bioma, Dueño, Asentamiento, Población, Natalidad/Mortalidad, Religiosidad, Felicidad, Hambre, Educación, Riqueza. - Toggleable map overlays: Vista Política (Países), Vista de Biomas, Densidad de Población, y Religiosidad.
2. Simulation Time System (Ticks): - Controls to Advance 1 Tick, Play/Pause automatic ticks, and speed selector. - Deterministic progression through the 5 Eras from the user's syllabus: 1. Era Primitiva (Fuego, Piedra, Domesticación, Mito) 2. Era Antigua (Escritura, Ciudad, Código de Leyes, Metalurgia) 3. Edad Clásica y Feudal (Rutas Comerciales, Cisma, Arquitectura, Herbolaria) 4. Era Industrial (Máquina de Vapor, Éxodo Rural, Método Científico, Guerra Total) 5. Era Tecnológica (Red Global, Genética, Energía Limpia)
3. Divine Powers (Reglas de Dios): - Interactive tool selector with a visual radius indicator (e.g., radio de 5 celdas) on the canvas: - "Lluvia de Abundancia" (Blessing in radius: reduces hunger, boosts population and wealth). - "Cataclismo Meteórico" (Disaster in radius: reduces population, alters terrain/happiness). - "Enviar Iluminado" (Spawns a prophet in a target country to found/spread religion based on population stats). - "Impulso Científico" (Triggers a tech roll in a region).
4. Real-Time Data Structures Inspector (Crucial for the Professor's Grading Rubric): - A dedicated visual panel showing the live state of the Data Structures powering the engine: - `std::vector` (Arreglo Dinámico): Shows memory layout index `x + y * width` of the selected cell and active countries vector. - `std::queue` (Cola FIFO): Shows the queue of routine demographic/tech rolls processed during the current Tick. - `std::priority_queue` (Cola de Prioridad / Max-Heap): Shows simultaneous events ordered by weight (Divine Wrath: 100, Prophet: 85, Epidemic: 70, Colonization Claim: 50, Tech: 30). - `std::stack` & Árbol N-ario de Estados (Multiverse Undo System): Allows the player to Undo/jump back to previous Ticks and branch into a new timeline when making a different divine action, visually displaying the timeline nodes.
